# AI Enablement Documentation

> Provider-neutral documentation for an AI enablement system: architecture layers, governance and authority, role-scoped memory, credential brokering, execution and replacement, visibility, resilience and cost control. Documents only. The Human principal is the highest authority. Version 0.1.0 (scaffold). Research is incomplete and every record states its parse status.

Notes: the vault is authoritative and the AI corpus is a projection of it. Claims carry labels (FACT, INFERENCE, RECOMMENDATION, UNRESOLVED, USER DECISION, USER REQUIREMENT, UNVERIFIED). Treat UNVERIFIED and RECOMMENDATION text as non-factual.
